Examples.Title: Create a chat completion
Examples.Description: Generate a chat completion from a sequence of messages. Returns a `ChatCompletion` object, or a server-sent events stream of `ChatCompletionChunk` deltas when `stream=true`. Supports tool calling, structured output via `response_format`, and reasoning controls.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Inception;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Create a decision
Examples.Description:
Evaluate named questions against a shared state with Mercury Decide. Supports binary probability (`noul`), categorical choice, and ordinal score questions. Returns answers and token usage. Streaming is not supported.

Images: put chat-style parts such as `{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/png;base64,..."}}` anywhere in `state` or a question's `instructions` (not in `criteria`). Images must be base64 PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF data URLs (remote URLs are not supported), at most 10 MiB each and 16 per upstream request. The complete JSON request, including base64 encoding, is also subject to the gateway's whole-request body limit (20 MiB by default).
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Inception;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Create a code edit completion
Examples.Description: Generate an edit to a code region given the surrounding context. The request must contain a single user message whose content includes the required edit prompt tags (e.g. `<|code_to_edit|>`, `<|cursor|>`, `<|current_file_content|>`). Returns an `EditCompletion` object. Streaming and tool calling are not supported on this endpoint.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Inception;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Create a fill-in-the-middle completion
Examples.Description: Generate a code completion given a `prompt` (prefix) and optional `suffix`. Designed for IDE-style inline completion. Returns a `FimCompletion` object, or a server-sent events stream of `FimCompletionChunk` deltas when `stream=true`. Tool calling and function calling are not supported.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Inception;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.
